findings.title: Reject sealed types in route path bindings even when unused
findings.reproduction: Append route GET /sealed-path/{id} { auth: none path: { id: ReminderIntentId } success: no_content action: {} } to the grounded fixture. Syntax is clean; entire analysis has only TYPE_JOB_DELIVERY_BINDING_NOT_IMPLEMENTED and one incomplete candidate, with no TYPE_JOB_DELIVERY_SEALED_USE.
findings.cause: The Route arm visits input/query/output/header references and inline bodies, but not route.path_fields. Normal transport checking accepts this nominal Uuid path field; no expression reads it, so inferred-value sealing does not see it.
findings.required_change: Apply the existing sealed field/reference rejection to every route.path_fields entry. Cover direct intent and field/alias/recursive sealed containment as applicable; keep actual graph/type identity and do not add prefix heuristics.
acceptance: Clean unused intent path binding emits TYPE_JOB_DELIVERY_SEALED_USE plus existing unsupported guard.
Checked export stays refused and no delivery job row/private checked model appears.
Ordinary unsealed nominal Uuid route paths remain unchanged.

findings.title: Run the exhaustive sealed-origin expression walk from route/job/fixture expressions
findings.reproduction: Clean syntax confirmed for six missing-seal cases: route.run extra sealed constructor; route.run extra selected-provider call; ordinary job.run extra sealed constructor; fixture clock invalid extra sealed constructor; fixture config invalid extra sealed constructor; fake accept invalid enclosing expression carrying a sealed receipt construction. All retain unsupported/error diagnostics but omit TYPE_JOB_DELIVERY_SEALED_USE.
findings.cause: The new raw AST expression walker correctly handles invalid/erased arguments when invoked from callable or inline bodies. It is never invoked for route.run; Job and Fixture declarations are skipped entirely. Ordinary inference zips only matched arguments, returns before invalid constructor children, or skips invalid fake response expressions, so these authored sealed origins are not inspected.
findings.required_change: Invoke the existing complete expression walker on the full route.run and job.run invocation, fixture clock, every config expression and accepted fake expression independently of ordinary inference success/arity. Audit other supported declaration expression slots for the same omission; this is source traversal, not hook/runtime work. Keep ordinary diagnostics and seal checks rather than suppressing errors.
acceptance: Each isolated route/job/fixture case in this report adds TYPE_JOB_DELIVERY_SEALED_USE while retaining existing argument-count/run/mismatch/unsupported errors.
Inspect every positional/named argument and nested construction/provider origin even under an invalid/erasing outer expression.
Keep current body extra-argument and recursive-containment negatives passing.
Removing all delivery descriptors preserves the actual unbound checked-service fixture and ordinary constructions/fakes.
